summary: Record was already complete (credit from the approved 34203487 context). The remaining pending sibling context 28761365 was verified against its PMC full text and approved without credit, so no pending-review context remains.

limitations: Context verified against the PMC full text (Methods; Results: 60 randomized, 55 questionnaire completers; wrinkle volume ratio vs placebo HA 300k p=0.046, HA 2k p=0.052) by agent review (Claude) on 2026-10-28; Dr. Pham's pre-approval of fully source-verified contexts attested by Sean on 2026-10-28. Not credit-bearing: no designated primary endpoint and a borderline single-arm result.

normalization.basis: Whole assigned material daily mass from primary Methods; not a marker or active-equivalent conversion.

identity.standardization: 95% hyaluronan purity by HPLC; no unreported molecular-weight equivalence inferred.

outcomes.name: Facial hydration and TEWL at 12 weeks; selected Cutometer and wrinkle outcomes favor treatment, while nonfacial raw hydration, Reviscometer elasticity and other skin-structure comparisons did not consistently separate from placebo. No unique primary endpoint is specified.

limitations: The fully inspected paper does not identify its primary outcome variable despite discussing sample-size power. This is a documented reporting limitation, not a manufactured primary endpoint.
Forty randomized participants, multiple measures and time points; selected positive comparisons cannot establish universal skin benefit.
Kewpie funded the study and employed three authors.
Signed A077 accepts limited skin findings only. No joint, longevity, generic-preparation equivalence, minimum effective dose or retail-batch purity claim.

dose.administration_frequency: One capsule containing 120 mg hyaluronan daily for 12 weeks; within-day timing not reported.
co_therapies: Skin supplements and prescribed skin treatment were excluded; ordinary cleanser, toner and moisturizer were permitted.

normalization.basis: Whole assigned material daily mass from primary Methods; not a marker or active-equivalent conversion.

source_provenance.location: Original full text Methods 2.1-2.9 and Results 3.1-3.7; no uniquely named primary endpoint.

source_receipts.title_fetched: Oral hyaluronan relieves wrinkles: a double-blinded, placebo-controlled study over a 12-week period
source_receipts.sections_used: Methods (trial design, supplements and dosage); Results
